headline: Congress named the Santaquin, Utah post office building after Sergeant Bill Hooser.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 20 West Main Street in Santaquin, Utah, as the SGT Bill Hooser Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or how the building is run.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
